_comment: Doc 1 §6.4. Rule C4 (never say 'you') deliberately breaks here and only here -- 'you' appears exactly once per card, in the signoff line. canon.text.js allows these three signoff lines as the only permitted 'you' occurrences besides the single S4-C manager line in system.json.
_harloweNote: harloweExtraLine fills Doc 1 §2.5's 'ending cards gain one extra line' for SAW_HARLOWE. Written 2026-09-17 at the user's direction; previously left null because Doc 1 specifies the line exists but never its text. Constraints it is written to: (1) no 'you' -- these lines are inside the card object canon.text.js counts, and the single permitted 'you' is the signoff's; (2) Doc 1 §9.3's guardrail -- Harlowe is 'a haunting instead of an easter egg', so no line adds a fact to chase or explains who Harlowe was; (3) lowercase, in Harlowe's own hand, matching manifest.json's row 019 register rather than the company's caps -- the company never acknowledges Harlowe, which is the whole motif. Rendered by main.js in .ending-harlowe-line (italic, 0.7 opacity, 0.85em), so it reads as a note in another hand, not a system message.

ending.assimilation.title: ONBOARDING COMPLETE.
ending.assimilation.harloweExtraLine: the role was occupied when the offer came through.

ending.expulsion.title: THE CANDIDATE'S APPLICATION HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN.
ending.expulsion.harloweExtraLine: the resignation was never finished either.

ending.pending.title: THE CANDIDATE'S FILE REMAINS OPEN.
ending.pending.body: VELLUM & ASHE WILL RESPOND WITHIN 6 MONTHS.
ending.pending.harloweExtraLine: the document is still open. unsaved, seven drafts in.

ending.retained._note: RETAINED: added post-launch (Doc 1 §9.1 left a fourth door open). Reached only via a near-perfect compliance run (would have been ASSIMILATION) where OPENED_BOX is also set -- he did everything right until the very last second.
ending.retained._harloweNote: Opening the box IS heeding row 019's 'whatever is in the box, do not sign for it' -- so on this ending alone Harlowe's warning was actually taken, and the file records it as the one exception anyway.
ending.retained.title: ONBOARDING COMPLETE. ONE EXCEPTION IS ON FILE.
ending.retained.body: THE CANDIDATE IS PERSONNEL. THE CONTENTS OF THE BOX ARE NOT RETURNED.
ending.retained.signoff: Welcome, you. It will not happen twice.
ending.retained.harloweExtraLine: nobody signed for it. that is not nothing.
